name: E-GIRL Next Door: Exposed
source:
E-GIRL Next Door: Exposed is a visual story about a gamer girl Lilly, who decided to switch her prospering gaming career for a life of a full time streamer. As she grew more popular on social media and streaming sites, she is slowly realizing this world is not so innocent as it seems to be! She soon finds out about the dark side of being popular.

Play as David, a handsome young man who just moved in right next to Lilly and has no idea what he got himself into! Alex wants to help Lilly with her difficult situation involving a stalker and he is immediately drawn by her charm. Will he manage to break through her walls and reach out to her heart? Or will he become just another fan?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2148230/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《E-GIRL Next Door: Exposed》是一部视觉小说，讲述女玩家Lilly放下蒸蒸日上的游戏事业，转而成为全职主播的故事。随着她在社交媒体和直播平台上的人气逐渐攀升，她也慢慢发现这个世界并没有表面看起来那么单纯，很快便窥见了走红背后的阴暗面。

你将扮演英俊的年轻男子David，他刚搬到Lilly隔壁，完全不知道自己卷入了什么事。Alex想帮助Lilly处理跟踪狂带来的麻烦，也立刻被她的魅力吸引。他能否敲开她的心扉、走进她的内心？还是会沦为又一个粉丝？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2148230/]Steam[/url]]
